HTTP-triggered L1 stale serving and real full-queue refresh drops
bounded L1 stale-if-error HTTP faults and transport disconnect
cases.not_exercised: exhaustive RFC directives and post-expiry transport fallback

probes.name: partition origin recovery with L1 persistence fallback
network recovered shared entry is readable
blackholed data commands fail within bounded HTTP budget
blackholed origin fetch persists via L1 fallback

not_exercised: encode and unknown-purpose StorageAPI cases: separately assigned to implementation child
